If a number is divisible by 99 which means it must be divisible by both 9 and 11.

We know that: A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all its digits is divisible by 9. A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of the odd digits and the sum of the even digits is 0 or divisible by 11.

3 + 1 + 5 + 4 + 8 = 21 [Not divisible by 9.]

6 + 0 + 6 + 8 + 7 = 27 [Divisible by 9.] And (6 + 6 + 7) - (0 + 8) = 11 [Divisible by 11]

4 + 4 + 7 + 7 + 5 = 27 [Divisible by 9.] And (4 + 7 + 5) - (4 + 7) = 5 [Not divisible by 11.]

8 + 4 + 4 + 5 + 6 = 27 [Divisible by 9.] And (8 + 4 + 6) - (4 + 5) = 9 [Not divisible by 11.]

Hence, 60687 is divisible by 99.

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in

the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Several times I have visited the narrow, dirty streets where the poor live, and I grow hot and indignant to think that good people should be content to live in fine houses and become strong and beautiful, while others are condemned to live in hideous, sunless tenements and grow ugly, withered and cringing.

B. Dear little creatures, they crouch in my heart and haunt me with a constant sense of pain.

C. The children who crowd these grimy alleys, half-clad and underfed, shrink away from your outstretched hand as if from a blow.

D. In the country one sees only nature's fair works, and one's soul is not saddened by the cruel struggle for mere existence that goes on in the crowded city.
questions.solution: After reading all the sentences thoroughly, we can say that D and A form a pair and D is followed by A because sentence D contrasts the city life described in sentence A with the countryside. Also, C and B form a pair. C describes the appearance and behaviour of the children living in the grimy alleys and B talks about the emotional impact the children have on the narrator. So, the order DACB form a coherent paragraph. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. Many species of bamboo flower once in several years and then die. B. The stem itself is hollow and is connected to a network of rhizomes, which spreads out beneath the surface of the soil. C. Roots grow out of this network of rhizomes and help the plants to absorb and distribute food and water from the soil. D. The bamboo is a variety of grass, with a woody, many-jointed stem.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Many species of bamboo flower once in several years and then die.

B. The stem itself is hollow and is connected to a network of rhizomes, which spreads out beneath the surface of the soil.

C. Roots grow out of this network of rhizomes and help the plants to absorb and distribute food and water from the soil.

D. The bamboo is a variety of grass, with a woody, many-jointed stem.
questions.solution: After reading all the sentences thoroughly, we can say that D and B form a pair as D introduces the bamboo stem, which is further described in sentence B. C and A also form a pair and C must come before A because sentence C talks about roots growing out of the network of rhizomes, which support the plant's absorption of nutrients, leading to the mention of the plant's life cycle in sentence A. So, the order DBCA form a coherent paragraph. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer. Anti-party activities / improved my relations /with an opposition.
questions.questionHtml:

Anti-party activities / improved my relations /with an opposition.
questions.solution:
The error lies in option (d), "with an opposition." The correct phrase should be "with the opposition" because "opposition" is being used as a collective noun referring to a specific group or entity, not just any opposition in general. So, "the" should be used to specify which opposition is being referred to. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

The correct sentence: Anti-party activities improved my relations with the opposition.

Note: A collective noun refers to a group of people, animals, or things as a single entity. Instead of referring to individuals separately, collective nouns describe them as a whole. The use of 'the' indicates that we are talking about a particular person or thing.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice. He was praised by his father.
questions.questionHtml:

He was praised by his father.
questions.solution: The given sentence is in the passive voice because the subject "he" is receiving the action "was praised" performed by the father. To convert this sentence into active voice, we need to make the subject ("his father") the doer of the action. The correct active voice sentence would be: "His father praised him." In this sentence, "His father" is the subject performing the action ("praised", simple past tense same as in the given sentence), and "him" is the object receiving the action. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.
